purpose: Exact Agent-State transition owned by the AGENT on a later direct HUMAN GO after a prior RESULT_SUBMITTED or BLOCKED execution has been terminally settled by MASTER.
rules: Use only on a later separate direct HUMAN GO after the current Agent-State is RESULT_SUBMITTED or BLOCKED and the prior MASTER Job is terminally settled.
For BLOCKED, the prior MASTER Job status must be REJECTED, CANCELED or SUPERSEDED.
For BLOCKED, provider-read back an immutable JOB_ERROR, CLARIFICATION_REQUEST or CAPABILITY_MISMATCH bound to the same project, prior job, agent and identity revision before rearm.
For RESULT_SUBMITTED, require the prior MASTER Job to be terminally settled before rearm.
The AGENT owns this transition; MASTER must never write or reset Agent-State.
Increment revision by exactly one and set runtimeStatus to WAITING_HUMAN_GO.
Set session and currentJob explicitly to null.
The current HUMAN GO is not consumed by the rearm transition.
Validate the complete proposed state against targetSchemaRef before provider CAS and validate the full provider readback again afterwards.
After successful readback, continue the same direct HUMAN GO through current personal INBOX selection, HUMAN-GO evidence persistence/readback and the normal atomic claim.
Do not reuse the prior Job, prior activationId or prior claim.
